Ki Esse Tang Kumban Ai Nuksa 94 NAUNONGTHOH SAMLA PULE, ka jingthmu haba pynmih la kane ka kot ka long ban iarap la phi, ym dei ba phin shu shaniah tylli ha kane ka kot. Shwa ba phin pule ia kane ka kot phi la dei ban dep pule la kumno kumno lai sien ia ki kot kiba ka Board ka la biih na ka bynta jong phi. Bun ki samla Khasi ki khein sting la ka Khasi namar ba ka dei ka ktien la jong. Ngi dei ban kynmaw ka jingburom la ka jait bynriew ka dei shwa na ka ktien namar “Haba ka ktien ka im ka jait bynriew ka im” ong u H. Elias. Dei ha ka ktien ba la buh lut ia ki akor, ki riti ki dustur bad ka kolshor jong ka jait bynriew Khasi hi. Nga kit bok kit rwiang ia phi, lada phi shem ba ka iarap to nang pynphriang ia la ka jong ka ktien lyngba ki kam jong phi man la ka sngi. KHUBLEI.

Sylvanus Lamare Ka Sien Shon Ba-Ar Ha kane ka sien shon nga la kham pynheh khyndiat ia kane ka kot da ka jingthmu ban iarap. Nga ngeit skhem ba *U Blei U Iarap ia kito kiba Iarap ia lade*; nga mut, dei ban pynshitom da kaba pule bniah la ki kot kiba ka Board ka la buh ha kane ka sobjek ym ban shu shaniah tylli ha kane ka kot. Khublei ryngkat ka jingkit bok kit rwiang. * Sylvanus Lamare 4 Ki Kot Khasi Ha Klas XII Q.01. Mynno kine ki kot harum ki la mih pyrthei nyngkong eh? i) Ka Myntoi Dykhot I Lane Ka Kot Boit Jubab: Ha ka snem 1888. ii) Ka Jingsneng Tymmen Bynta U. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1903. iii) Ki Poetry Khasi. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1957. iv) Na Nengpei Ki Sur Myllung. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1971. v) Ha Ki Sur Ka Poetry. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1984.

vi) Phuit! Ka Sabuit! Jubab: Ha ka snem 1968. vii) Katto Katne Shaphang Ka Sonnet. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1979. viii) Ka Grammar. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1987. xi) Na Mihngi-Sepngi. Jubab: Ha ka snem 1958. Ai ia ka kyrteng ba pura jong ki nongthoh ia kine ki kot harum:- i) Ka Myntoi Dykhot I Lane Ka Kot Boit Jubab: Sheikh Muhammed Amjad Ali. ii) Ka Jingsneng Tymmen Bynta II Jubab: Radhon Singh Berry Kharwanlang. iii) ifi Poetry Khasi Jubab: Victor G. Bareh. iv) Na Nengpei Ki Sur Myllung 5 Jubab: B.Chedrack Jyrwa.

v) Ha Ki Sur Ka Poetry Jubab: Sondar S.Majaw. vi) Phuitl Ka Sabuitl Jubab: Simon Jenkin Duncan. vu)Katto Katne Shaphang Ka Sonnet Jubab: Bevan Lionel Swer. viii) Ka Grammar Jubab: H.Warmphaign Sten. ix) Na Mihngi-Sepngi Jubab: Hopewell Elias. Ai la ka kyrteng ba pura jong ki kot ba la thoh da kine harum:- i) S.M.Amjad Ali Jubab: Ka Myntoi Dykhot I Lane Ka Kot Boit (Poetry) Ka Ba Nyngkong. ii) Radhon Singh Berry Jubab: Ka Jingsneng Tymmen Shaphang Ka Akor Khasi Ha Ka Rukom Rwai Phawar. iii) S.J. Duncan Jubab: Phuitl Ka Sabuitl Bad Kiivei Kiwei De Ki Khana. Ai ia ka jubab jong kine harum:- a. Memo ba la lum lang ia ki poem ha ka kot Na Ka Thiar Ki Longshmua? Jubab: R.S.Lyngdoh, H.W.Sten bad B.L.Swer. Ha ka snem aiu ka kot Na Ka Thiar Ki Longshuwa ka la mih pyrthei nyngkong eh? Jubab: 1980.

Mano ba la pynmih pyrthei la ka kot Na Ka Thiar Ki Longshuwa? Jubab: Ka Khasi Authors Society (K.A.S). Mano ba la thoh la kine ki poem harum:- a. “Ka Sor Shillong* Jubab: B.C.Jyrwa. “Ym Dei U Nongthaw" Jubab: B.C.Jyrwa. “Jingshai Na Ki Syrdeng* Jubab: B.C.Jyrwa. “U Nongshna Dur" Jubab: B.C.Jyrwa. “U Tiewdohmaw Ha Shiteng Riat* Jubab: V.G.Bareh. “Ka Wah Umkhrah* Jubab: V.G.Bareh. “Hapdeng Ki *Law Kynjah Ka Tlang* Jubab: V.G.Bareh. “Topu* Jubab; S.M.Amjad Ali. “U Tai Bad U Ba Duk* Jubab: S.M.Amjad Ali. “U Nongkhaii Bad U Napit* Jubab: S.M.Amjad Ali. “Ka Shnong Jingthala* Jubab: S.S.Majaw.

Kine ki poem harum ki don mar katno dkhot? -“U Tiewdohmaw Ha Shiteng Riat* Jubab: 3 dkhot. “Hapdeng Ki *Law Kynjah Ka Tlang* Jubab: 5 dkhot. “Ka Wah Umkhrah* Jubab: 7 dkhot. “Ka Sor Shillong* Jubab: 5 dkhot. *Ym Dei U Nongthaw” Jubab: 6 dkhot. “Jingshai Na Ki Syrdeng* Jubab: 19 dkhot. *U Nongshna Dur” Jubab: 9 dkhot. “Ka Shnong Jingthala" Jubab: 88 dkhot. “KA SHNONG JINGTHALA” Q.01. Mynno la thoh ia ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala"? Jubab: 06-09-1983. Ha ka kot aiu kane ka poem ka la mih pyrthei? Jubab: Ha Ki Sur Ka Poetry. Ha ki katno bynta la phiah la ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala"?

Jubab: Hynriew bynta. Ai ia ki dkhot kiba don ha ki bynta bapher bapher? Bynta I 12 dkhot Bynta II 10 dkhot Bynta III 24 dkhot Bynta IV 17 dkhot Bynta V 10 dkhot Bynta VI 15 dkhot. Ai la ka rukom hap kyntien ha ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala”? 8 Jubab: Ka bud la kane ka rukom hap kyntien abcb. Ka poem ‘Ka Shnong Jingthala” ka dei ka jait poem alu? Jubab: Ka dei ka ballad. Kumno ngi tip ba ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala” ka dei ka ballad? Jubab: Ngi tip ba ka dei ka ballad namar:- - Ka don saw lain shi dkhot, la thoh ha ka dur ka jinglathuh khana, ki lain 1 bad 3 ki bud ia ka tetrameter (phra kynnoh shi lain), ki lain 2 bad 4 ki bud ia ka trimeter (hynriew kynnoh shi lain) bad ka rukom hap kyntien ka long abcb (ka lain kaba ar ka hap kyntien bad ka lain kaba saw). Kaei ka Bawsis? Jubab: Ka dei ka puron kaba ngi shem ha ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala”, ka dei ka tnga jong u Philemon, ki shong ki sah shabar na ka shnong jingthala, bad kim don khun don kti. Ki jait briew alu ki shong shnong ha ka Shnong Jingthala? Jubab: Ki dei ki briew kiba sangrang ka dohnud, ki bym ju pynmih *tien ieit *tien sbun, kiba nang ban sei tang ki kyntien ka hangamei bad ‘tien amrang, ki *tien sat ‘tien jew, kiba mlien ka peit mat kynriang, ka ktah mationg bad kiba leh ki kam kynsha. Kaei ka jinglong ki khynnah rit ha ka Shnong Jingthala?

9 Jubab: Ki khynnah rit ki kynshi kynii la ki nongwei, da la khmat ki thaw dur kynsha bad kim don ka akor. Q.ll. Hakaporbarimkipyrkhatkumnoshaphang ka ^ingbha? Jubab: Ki pyrkhat ba ka dei ka aih. Balei ka jingbha kam dei shuh ka ain ha kane ka ‘pyrthei kylla? Jubab: Namar na u briew la lip ka main. Batai lyngkot i'a ka ling trep u Philemon bad ka Bawsis? Jubab: Ka ling trep ka don harud nong ka Shnong Jingthala bad ka dei ka ling kaba la tap da u sder. Batai i'a ka dur ka dar u Jupiter? Jubab: U Jupiter u don ka main bakhraw, ka dur kaba bha briew, ka ryni'eng kaba jrong bad ka khlieh kaba heh. Batai la ka dur jong u Mercury? Jubab: U Mercury u don ka rynieng kaba lyngkot, u phong tupia, u bat u dieng duh ba la oh dur ha ka kti kadiang bad ha uta u dieng duh don ar tylli ki bsein kiba kyllain. Kiei ki jingbam kiba ka Bawsis bad u Philemon ki la ai ha ki riew phylla? Jubab: Ki la ai ha ki la u kpu, ka dud, ka umngap bathiang bad ki soh grape.

Balei ka Bawsis ka pisa haba kita ki riew phylla ki sdang ban bam? 10 Jubab: Namar ba ka tip balada kita ki new phyllaki pan bam shuh kan ym lah ban ai ha ki bad kan sa long ka jingleh rain kaba khraw. Kiei ki jingphylla kiba ka Bawsis bad u Philemon ki lap haba kita ki ar ngut ki dang bam? Jubab: Ki jingphylla ki long ka katba kita ki new phylla ki nang theh la ka dud na u kum katta ka nang dap; ka umngap ka kham stem, kham thiang bad kham bang; u sohwain ruh u thiang. KATTO KATNE SHAPHANG KA SONNET Q.01. Ka thymmei jong ka jingrwai sonnet ka dei na ka ri aiu? Jubab: Na ka ri Italy. Ai la ka jingmut ka kyntien sonnet? Jubab: “I sur i barit.” Q.03. Ka kyntien sonnet ka mih na kano ka kyntien? Jubab: Na ka kyntien Italy sonnetto. Ka kyntien sonnetto pat ka mih na ka kyntien aiu? Jubab: Na ka kyntien French barim sonnet Q.05. Ka kyntien sonnet ka dei ka jingpynrit jong ka kyntien son kaba mih na ka kyntien aiu?

Jubab: Na ka kyntien Latin sonus. Ka mut aiu sonus? Jubab: Ka mut ka jingsawa ne ka Iyer riew-sur. Kaei ka sonnet? Jubab: Ka dei ka lyric poetry, kaba ka don ka dur ka dur kaba thikna, kata 14 lain, 10 kynnoh ha kawei pa kawei ka lain bad ruh ka jingthew tara kaba la buh pyrkhing. Mano ba ong, “Ngan shah ia lade ban khot la kine, ki sonnet kiba kynthup khatsaw lain, bad man kawei pa kawei ka lain ka don shiphew kynnoh." Jnbab: U George Gascoigne. Ha ka spah snem kaba katno bad na kano ka jaka ka sonnet ka la sdang ban thylleng? Jubab: Ha ka spah snem kaba khatlai, na Sicily. Na Sicily ka sonnet ka la suh thied shano? Jubab: Sha Tuscany. Q.ll. Ha ka spah snem kaba katno bad ha ki kti jongno ka sonnet ka la sdang ban tynshain phymai? Jubab: Ha ka spah snem kaba khatsaw, ha ki kti u Petrarch. Iano la ju niew kum u Kpa ka jingrwai sonnet?

Jubab: la u Francesco Petrarch. Uei u Francesco Petrarch? Jubab: U myllung bakhraw ka ri Italy (1304-1374). Kat kum u Theodore Watts Dunton uei u nongthoh sonnet banyngkong tarn? Jubab: U Fra Guittone d’ Arezzo. lano la niew kum u nongprat lynti ia kane ka rukom thoh poitri? Jubab: la u Pierro Delle Vigne. Ia ki jait jingrwai aiu la niew kum ki symbai ka jingrwai sonnet? Jubab: la ki jingrwai ba ki khot strambotto. Kaei ka strambotto? Jubab: Ki dei ki jait jingrwai kiba kynthup ar tylli ki quatrain bad bud da ka refrain kaba hynriew lain. Ki jait jingrwai aiu la pynlasyriem bad ki jingrwai sonnet? Jubab: Ki long conzone. sormetto , bad baletta.

Kaei ka conzone? Jubab: Ka jingrwai khlem ka out ka tem. Q JO. Kaei ka sonnetto? Jubab: Ka jingrwai ryngkat bad ka put ka tem. Kaei ka baletta? Jubab: Ka jingrwai ryngkat bad ka put ka tem iem bad kajingshad. Mano ba la wanlam nyngkong eh la ki quatrain bad tercets ha ka rukom thoh sonnet? Jubab: U Fra Guittone d’ Arezzo. Uei u Dante Alighieri? Jubab: U nongthoh ba khraw tarn jong ka ri Italy. Ai ia ka kyrteng jong ka kot ha kaba la lum lang la ki sonnet u Dante Alighieri? Jubab: La vita nouvo. Shaphang jongno u Dante u la thoh sonnet?

Jubab: Shaphang kaba ieit jong u ka Beatrice. Katno tylli ki sonnet u la thoh shaphang ka Beatrice? Jubab: 51 tylli. Ai nulcsa la ki quatrain u Dante? Jubab: abba abba. Ai nuksa ia ki tercets u Dante? Jubab: cdc dcd; cdd ded; cde cde; cd cd cd. Ka mut alu quatrain? Jubab: Ka mut saw lain. (Ka wan na ka kyntien Latin quattor, kaba mut saw). Ka mut aiu tercets ? Jubab: Ka mut hynriew lain. Kaei ka Beatrice ha ki sonnet u Dante? Jubab: Ka dei ka kynja ksiang hapdeng ka jingshisha u Blei bad ka jingieit, kaba ai mynsiem ban ieit la u Blei, bad ka pansngiat ka dohnud u Dante.

Kaei ka bynta u Petrarch ha ka thoh sonnet? Jubab: U Petrarch u la ioh ia ka nam kum uba phymai tarn, u maw nongrim ba nyngkong tarn bad ba janai tarn ha ka thoh sonnet. Ha kano ka rukom u Petrarch u la phiah la ki sonnet jong u? Jubab: U la phiah la ki sonnet jong u ha ki octave bad sestette. Shaphang jongno u Petrarch u la thoh sonnet? Jubab: Shaphang ka Laura kaba long ka pansngiat jong u. Katno tylli ki sonnet u Petrarch u la thoh? Jubab: 367 tylli. Na ki 367 tylli katno tylli ki kren shaphang ka Laura? Jubab: 317 tylli. Jer kyrteng ia ka kot ha kaba u la lum la kine ki sonnet? Jubab: Canzoniere. Kamo tylli ki sonnet u Petrarch u la thoh haba ka Laura ka dang im? Jubab: 266 tylli. Ia Ki sonnet u Petrarch la khot kumno ha ka thoh ka pule?

Jubab: Italian sonnet lane Petrarchan sonnet. Ha ka alom alu u Petrarch u la paw kum u nongthoh sonnet ba paw khmat? Jubab: Ha ka alom Renaissance. Ha ka spah snem kaba katno ki sonnet u Petrarch ki la ioh rung ha England? 15 Jubab: Kaba Khat-hynriew. iano la hiew kum u nongthoh sonnet ba t'vngkong tam ha ka ktien English? Jubab: U Sir Thomas Wyatt. U Thomas Wyatt u la thoh katno lylli ki sonnet? Jubab: 31 tylli (10 ki dei ki translation na ki jong u Petrarch). Ha kino ki bynta ki sonnet u Thomas Wyatt ki pher na ki jong u Petrarch? Jubab: Ha ka jaka ka sestette u pyndonkam da kawei ka quatrain bad kawei ka couplet. Ai la ka dur ka dar jong ki sonnet u Thomas Wyatt? Jubab: abba abba cddc ee. Ha kano ka rukom ki sonnet jong ki ri bapher ki lapher?

Jubab: - Ha ri France la thoh la ki ha ka Alexandrine (jamdien 12 kynnoh shi lain) - Ha ri Italy la thoh la ki .ha ka Hendecasyllables (jamdien 11 kynnoh shi laid). - Ha ri England la thoh la ki ha ka Decasyllables (jamdien 10 kynnoh shi lain). Niew kyrttag la u nongthoh uba la pynpher la ki dur ki sonnet jong u na ki jong u Petrarch bad Wyatt? Jubab: U Henry Howard Earl of Surrey. Ai la ka dur ka dar ki gomiet u Surrey? Jubab: abab cdcd efef gg. Ki sonnet u Surrey ki long kUnmo? Jubab: Ki sonnet u Surrey ki kham pynbang pynthiang la ka English literature. Q.b'O Ai la ka dur ka dar jong ki sonnet u Edmund Spencer- Jubab: abba bcbc cdcd ee ." 5 1 <J Spenser u ai kyrteng kumno la ka thup •> i et jong ul T Amorett • Q. "2 U .a lum katno tylli ki sonnet ha kane ka thup? iu«‘cb: 80 tylli Q 43. Kita ki sonnet ki kren shaphang jongno? Shaphr.ig ka jingieit jong u bad ka Elk,. beth (kaba kim pat thikna haduh mjnita).

Kdew la ka dur ka dar ki Shakespearean sonnet 0 Jubab: abab cdcd efef gg. Ai la ka kyrteng ka thup ha kaba u Sir Philip Sidney u la lum la ki sonnet jong u? Jubab: Astrophel and Stella. U la lum katno tylli ki sonnet ha kane ka thup? Jubab: 108 tylli. Shaphang jongno u la thoh la ki sonnet? Jubab: Shaphang ka Penelope Devereux. Ai la ka dur ka dar ki sonnet u Sidney? Jubab: abba abba cde cde. Ha ka thup sonnet kaba u Shakespeare u la lum u la ai burom lano? Jubab: la u Mr. Kat kum ki kritdk kaei ka kyrteng pura jong WH? Jubab: William Herbert, Earl of Pembrooke. Shaphangjongno u Shakespeare u la thoh sonnet?

Jubab: Shaphang ka Dark Lady (kaba ym don ba tip haduh mynta). U William Wordsworth u la thoh kumba katno tylli ki sonnet? Jubab: Kumba san spah tylli. Ai la ka dur ka dar ki sonnet u Wordsworth? Jubab: abba acca de de de. U John Keats u la thoh katno tylli ki sonnet? Jubab: 65 tylli. Ia ka dur kaba kumnoki sonnet u Keats ki bud? Jubab: Ia ka dur ka Italian sonnet. Uei u nongthoh sonnet uba kham paw ha ka oe ka spah snem? Jubab: U Rainer Maria Rilke. Hakanokathupulalumlakisonnetjongu? Jubab: Sonnet to Orpheus. Ka octave ka don katno lain?

Jubab: Phra lain. Shi quatrain don katno lain? Jubab: Saw lain. Shi sestette don katno lain? Jubab: Hynriew lain. Shi tercet don katno lain? Jubab: Lai lain. Ai Ta kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka tercet? Jubab: Terza rima. “KI JINGRWAI LA -KA-RI HA INDIA” Q.01. Kaei ka jingthmu jong ki jingrwai la ka ri? Jubab: Ka jingthmu jong ki jingrwai la ka ri ka long, ban dwai ban kyrpad la ka jingkyrkhu jong u Blei halor jong ka ri bad ki nongsynshar lane ban ai jinglaroh la la ka ri kum ka mei-rilung ka mei-risan. Jia alu haba pynrwai lane pyntem la ki jingrwai la ka ri? Jubab: Haba pyntem lane pynrwai la ka jingrwai la ka ri, ka pynkmen, ka pynshlur, ka pynkhraw dohnud bad ka pynsngew myllung dohnud, khamtam la ki trai jong kito ki jingrwai.

Ha Ri India don katno tylli ki jingrwai la ka ri? Kiei kita? Jnbab: Ha Ri India don ar tylli ki jingrwai la ka ri; kita ki long, Ka Bande Mataram bad ka Janaganamana. Mano ba la thoh la kine ki jingrwai la ka ri ha India bad ha ka ktien alu? Jubab: la ka Bande Mataram la thoh da u Bankin’ Chandra Chatteiji ha ka ktien Sanskrit; katba la ka Janaganamana la thoh da u Rabindranath Tagorr ha ka ktien Bengali Q. Ha ka kot alu ka Bande Ma. at turn ka la imh pyrthei nyngkong eh 0 Jubab: Ha ka kot jong u Bankim Chandi'a Chatierji kaba u la ai kyrteng Ananda Math ha ka snem 1882. Mano ba la shna sur la ka Bande Mataram? Jubab: U Rabindranath Tagore Q.07. Ha ka snem alu la rwai nyngkong eh Ta ka Bande Mataram bad ha kano ka jingTalang'^ Jubab: La rwai nyngkong eh ha ka snem 1896, ha ka jingialang jong ka Dorbar Pyllun ka Kongi es ka ri India. Uei u Bankim Chandra Chatteiji? Jubab: U dei u nongthoh bakhraw nam ha ka ktien Bengali. U la thoh bun tylli ki* kot jingiathuh khana kiba la pynkylla sha kiwei pat ki jait ktien jong ka pyrthei. Da ka jingrwai Band* Mataram u nong India u leh alu?

Jubab: Da kane ka jingrwai, u nong India, u khot Kmie !a ka India, namar dei maka kaba bsa kaba btiah la u, kaba pynsan pynrangbah bad kaba thum bad kaba kdup kumba ka kmie ka leh. U lohi la ka jingkhraw bad ka bor, ka jingbha briew bad jingiphuh iphieng. U shaniah ha ka bad u kloi ban lap na ka bynta jong ka da kaba ong, “Nga nguh la phi, ko Mei”. Uei u Rabindranath Tagore? Jubab: U dei u nongthoh bakhraw nam jong ka Bengal bad ka ri India. U long u nongrwai ba paw nam bad u nongthoh poitri ba ka pyrthei ka tip. U long ruh u Stad pyrkhat ba jylliew shibun. Ha kano ka snem la shon nyngkong eh la ka Janaganamana bad ha kano ka kot? Jubab: La shon nyngkong eh ha u Kyllalyngkot jong ka snem 1912 ha ka kot khubor kaba kyrteng Tattbabodhini Patrika. Mano ba la khot la ka Janaganamana ka jingrwai blei? Jubab: U Mahatma Gandhi, u Kpa ka jait bynriew India. Ha ka snem alu u Rabindranath Tagore u la pynkylla aha ka English la ka Janaganamana bad kaei ka kyrteng kaba u la ai? Jubab: Ha ka snem 1919, u la khot la ka, ka Jlngrwai-8t*p jong ka India. Ha ka snem alu la rwai nyngkong eh la ka Janaganamana bad ha kano ka jingialang?

Jubab: Haka27 tank u Nohprahjongka snem 1911, ha ka jingialang Dorbar ka Kongres. Kaei kaba la pdiang la ka Janaganamana kum ka Jingrwai la ka Ri bad ha ka snem alu? Jubab: Ka Dorbar Thaw-ain jong ka India ha ka 24 taiik u Kyllalyngkot jong ka snem 1950. Da ka jingrwai Janaganamana u nong India u leh alu? Jubab: Da kane ka jingrwai u nong India u iaroh la U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw ba U long U Kynrad jong ka India. la U kiwei ki bynta jong ka India ruh ki laroh ryngkat ki bynriew kiba shong ha ka. Na U ki kyrpad la ki jingkyrkhu namar U long ka Jingim Bad ka Jingpynim; kumta la U ki risa. Kaei ka jingthmu da ki jingrwai la ka Ri? Jubab: Ka jingthmu jong kine ki jingrwai la ka Ri ka long ban khot la baroh ki nong India ban latylli ha kaba tei la la ka Ri. Ka India ka dei ka Kmie jong ka Jait bynriew bad man u nong-India u dei ban ieit la ka kum la la ka jong ka kmie. Ka dei ka Ri tip-blei tip-briew bad la khmih lynti ba uwei pa uwei u nong India u dei ban pyndep hpk la ka kamram. “KA TREI KA KTAH HA RI KHA8I<JAlftTIA” Q.01. Ki Khasi ki long kiba kumno ha ka trei ka ktah? 22 Jnbab: Ki Khasi-Jaintia ki long ki briew kiba amat bad ba minot shibun ha ka trei ka ktah. Kim ju riej ban trei la kano kano ka kam.

Kim ju leh raifi ne hiew poh la kano kano ka jingtrei. Malu mala ha ki katno bynta lah ban pynbynta la ka Ri Khasi-Jaihtia? Kiei kita? Jubab: Ha ki lai bynta. Ka bynta ba sharum, ka thain Ri-War; ka bynta ba hapdeng, ka thaih Ri- Lum bad ka bynta ba shaneng, ka thain Ri-Bhoi. la kano ka thain la hiew kum ka kper Eden jong ka Ri Khasi-Jaintia? Jubab: Ia ka thain Ri-War. Kijait syntiew aiu ngi ioh na ka thain Ri-War? Jubab: Ngi ioh la u ‘tiewlasubon, u ‘tiew-diengngai bad u ‘tiew-shympa. Kijait soh aiu ngi ioh na ki thain Ri-War? Mynno la thoh ia ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala"? Jubab: 06-09-1983. Ha ka kot aiu kane ka poem ka la mih pyrthei? Jubab: Ha Ki Sur Ka Poetry. Ha ki katno bynta la phiah la ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala"?

Jubab: Hynriew bynta. Ai ia ki dkhot kiba don ha ki bynta bapher bapher? Bynta I 12 dkhot Bynta II 10 dkhot Bynta III 24 dkhot Bynta IV 17 dkhot Bynta V 10 dkhot Bynta VI 15 dkhot. Ai la ka rukom hap kyntien ha ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala”? 8 Jubab: Ka bud la kane ka rukom hap kyntien abcb. Ka poem ‘Ka Shnong Jingthala” ka dei ka jait poem alu? Jubab: Ka dei ka ballad. Kumno ngi tip ba ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala” ka dei ka ballad? Jubab: Ngi tip ba ka dei ka ballad namar:- - Ka don saw lain shi dkhot, la thoh ha ka dur ka jinglathuh khana, ki lain 1 bad 3 ki bud ia ka tetrameter (phra kynnoh shi lain), ki lain 2 bad 4 ki bud ia ka trimeter (hynriew kynnoh shi lain) bad ka rukom hap kyntien ka long abcb (ka lain kaba ar ka hap kyntien bad ka lain kaba saw). Kaei ka Bawsis? Jubab: Ka dei ka puron kaba ngi shem ha ka poem “Ka Shnong Jingthala”, ka dei ka tnga jong u Philemon, ki shong ki sah shabar na ka shnong jingthala, bad kim don khun don kti. Ki jait briew alu ki shong shnong ha ka Shnong Jingthala? Jubab: Ki dei ki briew kiba sangrang ka dohnud, ki bym ju pynmih *tien ieit *tien sbun, kiba nang ban sei tang ki kyntien ka hangamei bad ‘tien amrang, ki *tien sat ‘tien jew, kiba mlien ka peit mat kynriang, ka ktah mationg bad kiba leh ki kam kynsha. Kaei ka jinglong ki khynnah rit ha ka Shnong Jingthala?

9 Jubab: Ki khynnah rit ki kynshi kynii la ki nongwei, da la khmat ki thaw dur kynsha bad kim don ka akor. Q.ll. Hakaporbarimkipyrkhatkumnoshaphang ka ^ingbha? Jubab: Ki pyrkhat ba ka dei ka aih. Balei ka jingbha kam dei shuh ka ain ha kane ka ‘pyrthei kylla? Jubab: Namar na u briew la lip ka main. Batai lyngkot i'a ka ling trep u Philemon bad ka Bawsis? Jubab: Ka ling trep ka don harud nong ka Shnong Jingthala bad ka dei ka ling kaba la tap da u sder. Batai i'a ka dur ka dar u Jupiter? Jubab: U Jupiter u don ka main bakhraw, ka dur kaba bha briew, ka ryni'eng kaba jrong bad ka khlieh kaba heh. Batai la ka dur jong u Mercury? Kiei ki jingbam kiba ka Bawsis bad u Philemon ki la ai ha ki riew phylla? Jubab: Ki la ai ha ki la u kpu, ka dud, ka umngap bathiang bad ki soh grape.

Jubab: Haka27 tank u Nohprahjongka snem 1911, ha ka jingialang Dorbar ka Kongres. Kaei kaba la pdiang la ka Janaganamana kum ka Jingrwai la ka Ri bad ha ka snem alu? Jubab: Ka Dorbar Thaw-ain jong ka India ha ka 24 taiik u Kyllalyngkot jong ka snem 1950. Da ka jingrwai Janaganamana u nong India u leh alu? Jubab: Da kane ka jingrwai u nong India u iaroh la U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw ba U long U Kynrad jong ka India. la U kiwei ki bynta jong ka India ruh ki laroh ryngkat ki bynriew kiba shong ha ka. Na U ki kyrpad la ki jingkyrkhu namar U long ka Jingim Bad ka Jingpynim; kumta la U ki risa. Kaei ka jingthmu da ki jingrwai la ka Ri? Jubab: Ka jingthmu jong kine ki jingrwai la ka Ri ka long ban khot la baroh ki nong India ban latylli ha kaba tei la la ka Ri. Ka India ka dei ka Kmie jong ka Jait bynriew bad man u nong-India u dei ban ieit la ka kum la la ka jong ka kmie. Ka dei ka Ri tip-blei tip-briew bad la khmih lynti ba uwei pa uwei u nong India u dei ban pyndep hpk la ka kamram. “KA TREI KA KTAH HA RI KHA8I<JAlftTIA” Q.01. Ki Khasi ki long kiba kumno ha ka trei ka ktah? 22 Jnbab: Ki Khasi-Jaintia ki long ki briew kiba amat bad ba minot shibun ha ka trei ka ktah. Kim ju riej ban trei la kano kano ka kam.

Kim ju leh raifi ne hiew poh la kano kano ka jingtrei. Malu mala ha ki katno bynta lah ban pynbynta la ka Ri Khasi-Jaihtia? Kiei kita? Jubab: Ha ki lai bynta. Ka bynta ba sharum, ka thain Ri-War; ka bynta ba hapdeng, ka thaih Ri- Lum bad ka bynta ba shaneng, ka thain Ri-Bhoi. la kano ka thain la hiew kum ka kper Eden jong ka Ri Khasi-Jaintia? Jubab: Ia ka thain Ri-War. Kijait syntiew aiu ngi ioh na ka thain Ri-War? Jubab: Ngi ioh la u ‘tiewlasubon, u ‘tiew-diengngai bad u ‘tiew-shympa. Kijait soh aiu ngi ioh na ki thain Ri-War? Jubab: Ki sohniamtra, ki sohkwid, ki sohkynphor bad ki sohtrun. Nalor ki bri soh, doh sa ki bri aiu ha Ri-War? Jubab: Don ki bri tympew bad ki bri kwai. Na Id sla sohtrun ki ioh aiu bad ki leh aiu ia ki?

Jubab: Ki ioh ki ksai kiba jwat bad ki thaih kynja iarong ne kynja jar. Kumno ki Khasi ki pyndon kam ia ka latyrpad? Jubab: Kum ka kynja musla jyntah. Ki kynthei ha Ri-War ki thaifi aiu da ki thri? Jubab: Ki thain shylliah, ki ruh, ki khoh, ki trab, bad ki “nup-rit Q. Kiba ha thaifi Ri-War ki trei aiu de? Jubab: Ki thong dohkha bad pynlong kha tyrkhong la ki ban pynpoi sha kiwei pat ki bynta ka Ri Khasi- Jaifitia. Kaei ka jait jingtrei kaba kham kongsan eh ha ki thain Ri-Lum? Jubab: Ka jingtrei kaba kham kongsan eh ha ka thaifi Ri-Lum dei ka rep phan. ftiew kyrteng la ki jait phan ba ki briew ha thain Ri-Lum ki rep bha? J ubab: U phan mongor, u phan karo bad u phan sawlia. Na kitei ki jait phan haneng uno u phan uba kham paw bad la leh aiu ia u? Jubab: Uba kham paw dei phan mongor. La shalan la u sha ri Thor.

La leh aiu ia u phan karo bad u phan sawlia? Jubab: La pyndonkam tang hapoh ri Khaai-Jaifitia. Ki shynrang ha kane ka thaifi Ri-Lum ki tbit bha ha ka kam aiu? Jubab: Ki tbit bha ha ka kam Mistri-maw, Mistri- dieng bad Mistri-nar ne Kamar. Kum ki Mistri-dieng ki tbit bha ban shna aiu? 24 Jubab: Ban thaw ling, ki kynja jynbuh jynsat ha ung kum ki almari, ki miej bad ki shuld. Kum ki Mistri-maw pat ki tbit ban tei alu? Jubab: Ban stah maw, ban tei mot, ki kynja maw shong thait bad ban maramot la ki fynja kor. Kum ki Mistri-nar ne Kamar, ki tbit ban shna aiu? Jubab: Ban thaw wait, moh khiew, ki lyngka bad ki kynja tiar mong kum ki khiew, ki siang bad ki dabor. Ki jait jingtrei aiu de ki shynrang ha kane ka thain Ri-Lum ki trei? Jubab: Ka kam khai'i, bad ruh kum ki nongtrei ha ki par maw bad ki par dewiong. Kijaitjingthungaiu kibriewhakineki thaifi Ri-Lum ki thung? Jubab: Ki rep u kba lum, u kba hali, u riewhadem, u krai, u iymbai, u sohphlang, ka shriew, u shynrai, u sying, u sohmynken bad katto katne ki jait soh.

Kaei ka jait kam ba ki kynthei ki tbit bha ha kane ka thain Ri-Lum? Jubab: Ban shna ki khiew khyndew, ki khiew ranei bad ki kyrya pliang saraw. Kaei ka jingiapher ha ka jingthaift da u thri hapdeng ki kynthei ha Ri-War bad Ri-Lum? Jubab: Ki jingthaifi jong kiba ha Ri-War ka kham ni ban la ka jong kito kiba ha Ri-Lum. Ha Ri-Lum ki leh alu la ki masi, ki blang, ki syiar bad ki sniang? Jubab: Ki die pateng lane ki shoh doh. Ha Ri-Lum ki leh alu da u kynphad ba ki thir ksai? Jubab: Ki thain la ki kynja jain spur. Kano ka thain kaba lah ban buhai khaw la ka Ri Khasi-Jairitia baroh kawei lada trei bha la ka? Jubab: Ka Ri-Bhoi. Ki briew ha ki thain Bhoi ki im da kaei? Jubab: Ki im da ka rep bad ka thain jain. Kaei kaba khang lad la ki briew ban pyndon kam bha la ka jingsei soh jong ka Ri Bhoi? Jubab: Ka khieshoh-rieh.

(khieshoh rih). Kiei ki sung? Jubab: Ki dei ki jaka rep kiba sboh bha ha ki thain Bhoi. Ha kine ki jaka rep kat kaba rep yin ju long leh nohei. ftiew kyrteng la ki jait jain kiba ngi loh na ki thain Bhoi? Jubab: Ki long ki jain-kup ryndia, ki ryndia stem, ki khyrwang bad ki jaih-spur. Nangno la loh la u sai ryndia? Jubab: Na ki sop ki khniang ryndia kiba ki da ri khnang bad bsa da ki sla u dieng ryndia. Kiei ki jait jingthung kiba kham kynrei ha ki thairi Bhoi? 26 Jubab: U soh new, u soh kynphor, ka kait, u krai, ka laha bad u kynphad. Ka jingrep aiu kaba pynduh ia ki khlaw bad pynkylla laid wir la ki briew? Jubab: Ka jingrep krai. “BADON-BUROM” Q.01. Ka kyntien “badon-burom” ka laid synrop bad kaei?

Jubab: Ka laid synrop bad ka jingdon peisa ne ka jingriewspah. Ka pynmih ia ka kyntien "Don Peisa, don burom”. Ka jingong “don peisa don burom 1 ' ka long kaba dei? Jubab: Ka long kaba bakla shibun, ym baroh uba don peisa u long uba don burom bad ym baroh u byin don peisa u long u bym don burom. Hato ka jingdon burom ka long madan? Jubab: Ka jingdon burom kam long madan hynrei ka don la ka jong ka kyrdan. Ka jingdon burom ka kdup hapoh jong ka la kaei? Jubab: Ka kdup la ka jingdon-akor.' Q.05. Nangno lah ban bishar ia ka jingdon-akor jong u briew? 27 Jubab: Na ka laid ka ieng, ka ktien ka thylliej bad ki rukom leh jong u briew. Kaei ka bula kaba u briew u kup ban iada ia lade? Jubab: Ka jingarsap. U briew uba don burom u dei ban leh alu? Jubab: U dei ban burom ia lade.

Ka mut alu ban burom ia lade? Jubab: Ka mut ban leh don akor, ban shaniah ha lade ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat, ha ka ktien ka thylliej bad ha ki kam ki jam baroh. ftiew kyrteng ia ki katto katne ki jinglong jong u briew uba don burom shisha? Jubab: U briew uba don burom da shisha u kup ia kine ki jinglong harum: - U kiar na kaba pyrkhat sniew shaphang kiwei. - Um suba sniew, peit sniew, tharai sniew ne mut sniew la kiwei. - U kiar na ka jingbym iadei jingmut. - U kiar na kaba woh dong ne woh nia. - U leh bha, leh sbun bad leh ieit ia baroh. - Um ju kren shaphang ia lade, hiar eh ba un pynmih ia ka ma-nga. - Um khwan buit, khwan bor ne khwan spah. - U long uba shida bad uba sngew rit. U briew uba don burom u dei ti jait .briew alu? Jubab: U briew uba shisha. 28 “KA JINOSNGBWTTNNAT JONG KA JINGPULE- KOT" Q.01. Ka jingpule Ifibt ka leh aiu ha u briew?

Jubab: Ka jingpule kot ka pynroi !& ka jingnang jingtip, ka pyniar ia ka rukom pyrkhat bad ka bor pyrkhat jong u briew. U briew uba pule kot u long u briew ubakumno? Jubab: Ulongu briew uba shem phang, uba sngewthuh ia ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiwei bad uba iar kajingmut jingpyrkhat Q.03. Ia u briew uba la heh ka rta hynrei uba dang duna ha ka kyrdan pule ki Khasi ki ong kumno? Jubab: “Ka tynieng kat u siej, kajingmut pat dang biej.” Q.04. Ia u briew uba khim kajingmut jingpyrkhat la ianujor bad no? Jubab: La ianujor bad u ‘sew-ap-iing ha shiah ksew uba kli ia lade. la u briew uba minot ha ka jingpule bad uba ngam jylliew ki Knasi ki khot kumno? Jubab: U ‘Liengjathang kynjih sha Mawsiang bneng. Khnang ba ka jabieng kan long kaba koit ba khiah ka don kam ia kaei? Jubab: Ka don kam ia ka jingmlien ban pule, namar da kaba leh kumta ka ioh ban trei kam. Ki stad jingim ki ong kumno shaphang ka jingkoit jingkhiah? 29 Jubab: Ka met kaba koit ba khiah ka don kam la ka jabieng kaba trei kam. U Julius Kaisar u la lum ki jait kot alu ha ka librari jong u?

Jubab: U la lum la ki kot Latin bad Greek kiba u lah ban !oh ha kata ka por. Kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba u Julius Kaisar u la foh lyngba ka jingpule kot? Jubab: Ka jingminot ha ka jingpule kot ka la pynlong la u, u rangsaidthma uba pnah bad u nongthoh histori la ka jingleit hiar thma jong u, uba tbit. Uei uta u nonglalam ba pawn am jong ka Ri India uba la pynlut por ha ka jingpule kot? Jubab: U Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru. Kaei ka kyrteng tynrai jong u Pius XII? Jubab: Eugenio Pacelli. Katno tylli ki jait Ktien ka pyrthei u nang ban kren? Jubab: U nang ia ka Latin, Greek bad sa hynniew tylli kiwei pat ki ktien ka ri Europe. Ki briew kiba don por tang ban pule ia ki kot jingiathuh khaname ia ki kot khubor, ki leh kumno ia lade? Jtibab: Ki shukor ia lade; bad kaba shukor la lade ka long kaba sniew. Lada u briew um don shuh ka maifi bad um biang shuh kum u briew, kaei ka jaka kaba bit eh 30 ia u ban leit? Jubab: KaTespur. Balei sha Tespur?

Jubab: Ka del ka jaka shong jong ki bieit. Na ki Lum alu u Rip Van Winkle u la wan phai? Jubab: Na ki Lum Kaatskill. U Francis Bacon u ong kumno shaphang ki kot? Jubab: “Don ki kot, kiba shu dei ban mad, don kiba dei ban nguid, bad don kiwei pat kiba dei ban ktha bad ban tylliat.* Q.18. CJ H.Blias, u kren kumno shaphang ka kot kaba bha? Jubab: U ong ba ka long ka dawai ha ka jingim jong u briew; ka kam kordor ban la ka ksiar ha ki par ksiar ka Kolar; ki dei ki lok kiba bha bad kiba neh shi junom. Kaei ka Unibersiti ba shisha kat kum u Carlyle? Jubab: “Ka Unibersiti ba shisha jong kine ki sngi dei ka Jingpynlang ki Kot.* Q.20. Ka Thoh ka Tar ka lah ban leh alu ha ka jingim jong ngi ki briew? Jubab: Ka pynmyllen, ka hikai ban im bad ban lap bha, ka synran bad ka pynkhreh la ngi ban lakynduh la ka jingim ba man la ka sngi. 31 KA GRAMMAR Q.01. Ai la ka jingmut jong Pro bad noun? Jubab: Pro ka mut na ka bynta, noun pat ka mut ka kyrteng.

Kaei ka pronoun? Jubab: Ka dei ka klas kyntien kaba ieng ha ka jaka jong ka noun lane ka kyrteng. Kiei ki kamram kiba ka pronoun ka lah ban leh? Jubab: - Ka lah ban mih bujli la baroh ki noun ha ka jinglakren. - Ka pynlyngkot ia ka jingkren ne jingthoh. - Ka pynlait ia u nongkren na kaba jer kyrteng la lade ne ia kiwei pat. lano ka pronoun Nga ka kdew? Jubab: la u nongkren ne nongthoh. lano ka pronoun Me ka kdew? Jubab: Ka kdew ia u nongsngap uba lah ban don hajan ne hajngai tang ba u dei ban iohsngew ia kaba kren. lano ka pronoun Pha ka kdew? Jubab: Ka kdew ia ka ka nongsngap kaba lah ban don hajan ne hajngai tang ba ka dei ban iohsngew ia kaba kren. lano ka pronoun U ka kdew? Jubab: Ka kdew ia uwei pat u briew ubym dei u nongkren ne nongsngap, u lah ban don heyan u nongkren ne nongsngap lane shajngai.

Iano ka pronoun Ka ka kdew? Jubab: Ka kdew ia kawei pat ka briew ka bym dei ka nongkren ne nongsngap, ka lah ban don hcgan u nongkren ne nongsngap lane sheyngai. Iano ka pronoun Phi ka kdew? Jubab: Ka kdew sha u ne ka nongsngap ne ki nongsngap. Mano ba ong ba ka ktien Khasi kam don relative pronoun? Jubab: U Hugh Roberts ( 189 1) bad u Mondon Bareh (1929). Kaei ka determiner? Jubab: Ka dei ka klas kyntien kaba pynthikna ia ka sex bad number jong ka noun. Ha ka ktien Khasi don katto tylli ki determiner? Jubab: Lada bud beit tang ha ka jingbatai ba ka determiner ka pynthikna ia ka sex bad number, ka ktien Khasi ka don tang ar tylli ki determiner kata u bad ka. Hynrei ki don ruh kiwei kiba pynthikna ia ka number kum ki bad L Q. Ai nuksa ban pyni ba ka determiner ka paw ha khmat ka noun, ka verb bad adjective? U khynnah u long u babha D N D V D A Q. Ai kawei ka nuksa ban pyni ia ka noun ka bym donkam determiner?

33 Jubab: U wan shnong. D V N Q. Kaei ka Adjective? Jubab: Ka dei ka klas kyntien kaba pyndep la kine ki kam: - Ka pynshai la ka noun. - Ka hiew la ka jingdon jong ka noun ne kyrdan ba ka noun ka bat. - ka kdew la ka jinglong ka noun. - Ka lanujor la ka noun bad kawei ne kiwei pat ki noun. Ai nuksa la ka noun kaba long adjective? Jubab: nngjaifl, ling maw, miet Hang, miet lyiur. (jain, maw, tlang, lyiur ki dei ki noun lada shim tang marwei hynrei hangne ki dei ki adjective). Ai nuksa la ka adjective kiba long noun? Jubab: Ha kane ka juk u baduk u thiah suk mynmiet.(baduk ka dei ka adjective hynrei hangne ka long noun). Ai nuksa la ki abstract noun kiba kylla long adjective? Jubab: U wan na ling JingkhawaL U la leit sha ri jingstad.

U wan na ri jingshai ( jingkhawcd, jingstad bad jingshai ki dei ki adjective namar ki pynshai shuh shuh la ka noun ling, bad ri). alb haba -ka noun ka snoh bad ka adjdbVve? 34 Jubab: Haba ka noun ka snoh bad ka adjective, ka pynmih la ka noun thymmai. Nuksa : ‘riew+sniew=riewsniew; syiem+lieh* syiemlieh. Pyni kunrno la pynlong ia ka comparative degree ha ka ktien Khasi? Jubab: La pynlong ia ka comparative degree da kaba buh ia ka kynnoh kham ha khmat ka adjective. Pyni kumno la pynlong la ka superlative degree ha ka ktien Khasi? Jubab: La pynlong ia ka superlative degree da kaba buh ia ka kynnoh tarn hadien jong ka adjective. Kaei ka jaka jong ka adjective ha ka ktien Khasi? Jubab: Kham bunsien ka adjective ha ka ktien Khasi ka bud ia ka noun. Ai nuksa ban pyni ba ka adjective ka wan ha shwa jong ka noun? Jubab: Tymmen basan, Rangbah lyngdoh. Kiei ki kyntien kiba don ha ka kyrteng Preposition? Jubab: Ki kyntien ki dei pre bad position .

Pre ka mut shwa ne ha khmat bad position pat ka mut ka kyrdan ne jaka. Kaei ka Preposition? Jubab: Ka dei ka noun. Kaei ka adverb? Jubab: Ka dei ka klas kyntien kaba pynshai shuh shuh la ka verb lane ka adjective. Ai nuksa ban pyni ba ka adverb ka pynshai la ka verb bad adjective? Jubab: Kaba pynshai la ka Verb: U khynnah u march stet V Adv Kaba pynshai la ka Adjective: U soh uba stem mur-mur. V Adv Q.28. Kaei ka jaka kaba ka adverb ka ju shim ha ki senten Khasi? Jubab: Ka adverb ha ka ktien Khasi ka lah ban shim la ka jaka kaba hakhmat duh ka senten, ne kaba hapdeng ne kaba khatduh eh jong ka senten. Nuksa: Shen phin lohsngew na nga. Phin lohsngew shen na nga Phin lohsngew na nga shen. (Ka kyntien shen kaba dei ka adverb ka paw hakhmat duh ka senten, hapdeng bad haba kut ka senten). Kaei ka intensifier? Jubab: Ka dei ka Idas kyntien kaba pynkhia lane pynshai shuh shuh la ka adverb lane ka adjective.

Nuksa: U khynnah u march stet palat U khynnah u phong da ka soptijymgam tieh. (Ka kyntien palat ka pynshai shuh la ka adverb stet katbaka kyntien tieh patka pynshai shuh shuh la ka adjective). 36 NA KA THIAR KI LONGSHUWA Q.01. Ka trai u Topu ka shong hangno? Tubab: Ha Laban. Pyni kumno u Topu u pynpaw ia ka jingkohnguh fa la ka trai kynrad? Jubab: Haba u bud ia ka bad ma ka pat ka beh noh la u, shi syndon u phaidien bad leit phai sha la iing. Ha ka por janmiet ka jait kam aiu u Topu u pyndep? Jubab: U wad la ki syiar bad set fa ki ha sem. Da kaba dem hakhmat jingkhang u Topu u pyni fa kaei? Jubab: Ka pyni ba u la dep kam bad u ap lada ka trai ka don kam fa u. Haba ka trai kam don ha iing u Topu u leh aiu? Jubab: U ap ia ka iing bad um shah iano lano ban rung shapoh. Balei u Topu u pyniakhlad haba iapuh ne ladait ki para mrad?

Jubab: Namar u kwah jingsuk ha pyrthei bad ban ym don jingfashun paralok. Ha kano ka jaka u Syiem Hatim Tai u la iashem ia u baduk? Jubab: Ha khlaw. Ha ka por ba u Syiem Hatim Tai u lakynduh u Laduk u dang leh aiu? Jubab: U baduk dang trei kam. Halo uta u baduk u la ithuh ia u Syiem Tai? Jubab: Em. Shano u Syiem Tai u la phah la u baduk? Jubab: Sha u Syiem Hatim Tai. Q.ll. Banleiu Syiem Tai u la phah la u baduk shata? Jubab: Ba un ioh jingbam katba u mon u kwah bad ba un suk shirta. Balei u baduk u khlem treh ban leit sha u Syiem Hatim Tai? Jubab: Namar ba u dang don la kiktikikjal bad u dang lah ban trei bad u sngewpoh ban leit pan bain na kiwei.

Kaei ka khubor kaba u S.M. Amjad Ali u tyrwa lyngba ka poem “U Tai bad u Baduk”? Jubab: Ka khubor ka long, kamai bad bam da la ka umsyep. Kiei ki jinglong kiba kyrpang jong u nongkhau? Jubab: U longu briew uba bha, ubatipsngi, uba stad, > iba hok bad uba khraw ka bok. U nongkhali u la leh aiu la ka spah jong u kpa? wabab: U la sam sha kiba duk. Balei u nongkhau u la sam ia ka spah jong u kpa sha kiba duk? 38 Jubab: Ban pynsah la ka nam jong u kpa hangne ha pyrthei. U nongkhali u la leh alu hadien ba u la sam ia ka spah jong u kpa sha kiba duk? Jubab: U la leit kylla pu'kir. lano u nongkhali u la iohi ha ka jingphoh sniew? Jubab: la la ka nusib. y.ly.

Kaei ka jingkulai kaba ka nusib ka ai ha u mmgkhau? Jubab: Ba un wan ha ka dur u Bramman bad u nongkhali u dei ban tied bad ka met utau Bramman kan kylla ksiar. Jia aiu lada oi khyndiat ia kata ka ksiar? Jubab: Kan dap biang bad kan ym lut. Mano ba la don haba u nongicnaii u la bed i'a u Bramman? Jubab: U napit. U nongkhaii u la leh aiu ban pynsngap jar ia u napit? Jubab: U 1a ai shi lyngkhot ka ksiar khnang ba un ym lathuh briew. Kaei ka jingpyrkhat kaba la rung ha u napit? Jubab: Ba imat lada tied ia ki kynja Bramman namar ba ki dei kiba bha ka met jong ki kan kylla ksiar. U napit u la leh aiu haba u lohi shi kynhun ki Bramman? Jubab: U la pduh la ki khnang ba kin kylla ksiar. La jia aiu ia ki Bramman kiba shah pduh? Jubab: Ki la lynniar namar ka jingpang.

La jia aiu ia u nongkhaii? Jubab: U la shah pynshitom bad shah set patok. ‘KA AKOR KABA TAM” Q.01. Mano ba la wan pan thied nyngkong duh ia ka jeep u Kpa u Bor? Jubab: U Haripod. Kaei ka kam tuh kaba u Haripod u la leh? Jubab: U la tuh ia ki taiar jeep bad u ia pyndiat da kiba jot. Ban ai jingsneng ia lade u Kpa u Bor u la leh aiu? Jubab: U la bat shkor bad u la sdang na ka *kor kadiang. Mano ba la wan pan thied jeep hadien lai sngi? Jubab: U Holira. U Holira u shong u sah hangno? Jubab: Ha Nongthymmai. Da ki kyntien aiu u Kpa u Bor u kheiii sting ia u Holira?

Jubab: O, u para maijan du khat-ei. Haba u Kpa u Bor u leit tral la ka jeep bad u Holira jia alu? Jubab: U Holira u la pynher stet ia ka jeep bad u Kpa u Bor u sngew kumban phet ki snier bad u sngew ruh kumba ahong jet. Shano u Holira u la pynher la ka jeep? Jubab: Sha Motor ophis. Kaei ka kyrteng kaba u Kpa u Bor u la sin la u Holira? Jubab: U ‘erlangthari. Haduh katno u Kpa u Bor u la ap la u Holira ha Motor ophis? Jubab: Palatkynta. Kaei ka jingtip kaba u la loh na Motor ophis la u Holira? Jubab: Ba u la leit sha Kiewhati. Jia alu 1a u Kpa u Bor haba u iohsngew ba u Holira u la leit Kiewhati? Jubab: U la jan kylla lyndang. Kaei karai kaba u Kpa u Bor u la shim hadien ba u shah thoh ha u Holira?

Jubab: Ba u dei ban bat noh baroh ar tylli ki shkor. Mano bawan pan thied jeep hadien u Holira? Jubab: U Bhakhwandew. Kaei ka kyrteng kaba u Kpa u Bor u la sin la 41 u Bhakhwandew? Jubab: U pongding karai. U Kpa u Bor u la phah dor katno la ka jeep? Jubab: Lai hajar. Nyngkong duh u Bhakhwandew u la tyrwa katno? Jubab: Phra spah.
